create.name: Michelle Clare
create.bio:
Michelle Clare is a certified medium and angel communicator based in Phoenix, Arizona, whose teaching grows out of three near-death experiences. She first sensed a continuing bond with her grandfather after his death when she was twelve, and her later brushes with death left her with a lasting sense of a loving intelligence behind each life. The sudden loss of her partner in 2023 has since shaped how she speaks about grief.

For more than ten years she has given readings that connect people with loved ones in spirit, with angels and with what she calls life guides, and she places particular weight on the soul plan: the idea that each soul chooses key themes, relationships and lessons before birth. She holds private sessions and small group readings online, online galleries and occasional in-person events in Arizona, and teaches four-week online courses on soul plans, angels and spirit guides. On her YouTube channel she talks with near-death experiencers, mediums and other teachers about the afterlife and spiritual growth, and she has published two books of short channelled reflections, 101 Ways to Set Your Soul on Fire and 111 Angel Messages.

books.title: 101 Ways to Set Your Soul on Fire
books.author: Michelle Clare
books.description: A book of 101 short channelled reflections meant to be read one at a time, each turning the reader back towards their own sense of purpose.

books.title: 111 Angel Messages: Channeled Guidance
books.author: Michelle Clare
books.description: A collection of 111 brief messages she describes as coming from the angelic realm, offered as reassurance and companionship through change and loss.

courses.title: Unlocking the Secrets of Your Soul Plan
courses.description: An online course on the soul plan: agreements made before birth, soul groups, karma and dharma, and how to recognise the themes running through your own life.

courses.title: Connecting with your Angels: A 4-Week Odyssey
courses.description: Four weeks of guided meditations and exercises on the kinds of angels, how their presence and signs may be noticed, and how to build a working relationship with them.

courses.title: Sacred Connections: A 4-Week Course on Spirit Guides & Divine Guidance
courses.description: A four-week online course on spirit guides, from ancestors and nature guides to ascended masters, with grounding, meditation and visualisation practice for building contact over time.

courses.title: 60-Minute 1-on-1 Reading (online)
courses.description: A private hour online for a soul plan reading, angel guidance or contact with loved ones in spirit.

free_resources.title: How to Connect with Loved Ones (free session)
free_resources.description: A free recorded session, offered to people who found her through The Shift Network, on noticing signs from loved ones and setting up a quiet space to meet them.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @michelle_clare 79.1K subscribers (channel header, 5 Nov 2026); Instagram @medium_michelle_clare and Facebook not read (off limits) → ~79k readable → local_hero
flags: Shift named on: https://www.michelleclare.net/shift-webinar (free gift page 'Exclusive for The Shift Network attendees'); her events list also carries past 'Angelic Allies' dates.
Tier borderline: 79.1K on YouTube alone, Instagram unread; total may pass 100k.
Email shown under 'Contact Details' on her Wix booking pages (with Phoenix, AZ, USA); the Contact page itself has only a form.

Photo is her YouTube avatar only. static.wixstatic.com answered its robots.txt with 403, so its images (her site's photos) are not used; I had already downloaded six of them in the same step before reading that result (see slips).
Her bio mentions her partner's death by suicide (2023); not named in the listing bio beyond 'sudden loss'.

Her channel is mostly interviews with NDE survivors and mediums; a few titles are grief- or condition-led (addiction, mental breakdown, losing a child) and left out; the channel as a whole is afterlife-led, not condition-led. One recent title asks 'What Happens To Religion If Aliens Are Real?'.
left_out: 'How to Channel Healing Energy' and other recorded classes in her shop: product pages not opened; kept to the four main courses.
Connecting with Spirit Guides ($299): appears to overlap the Sacred Connections course; left out to avoid a duplicate.
Small group readings, online galleries, Alchemy with the Angels (10 Nov) and Into the Light (Sedona, 4 Feb): dated events.

Videos on grief and conditions (Losing a Child..., Loving a Daughter Through Addiction, Mental Breakdown or Spiritual Awakening?), 'Julie Ryan Can Scan Your Body Like An MRI' (medical intuition), members-only and short updates.
Mobile app: not launched on her site with a page of its own.
